comment: Single source for Stage 3's pinned parameters (ruling sec.4, claude-reply-d593faf). Stage 3 is the PAIRED fleet read: calibrated teacher vs raw v10, same seed + same seat per pair; Gravy mirror vs heuristic; instrument 87/62. teacher_tuple is byte-identical reuse of the Stage 2 tuple (H8k-180+H): the games runner builds TEACHER_TUPLE_JSON from it and the PREGATE-GATE block compares it against the Stage 2 pre-gate manifest (no new pre-gate run). label_tuple is Stage 2's L3 tuple, unchanged. Life score (games report and games analyzer, same definition): win -> 1; capped AND NOT draw AND own life strictly greater than opponent's -> 1; else 0, computed from the driver rows' p1life/p2life in the arm's seat frame.

timeout_derivation.rule: timeout = 1.50 x Stage 2 observed max game wall = 1.5 x 2143 = 3214.5 -> 3214 s (the ruling's kept value); the product-of-maxima derivation is RETIRED

bands.inconclusive: teacher timeouts > 2% of teacher games (final counts)
bands.impeachment: primary mean diff > +0.25: impeachment checks print before the read

l3.seed_family_clearance: bases used: Stage 0 855001, Stage 2 955001 (each + shard x 10^8, shard in 0..3 -> family spans [base, base + 300000000 + working range]); Stage 3 base 1055001: +100,000,000 above the Stage 2 base at every shard offset, disjoint from both prior families at every shard
